content.text:
Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status at the **preferred** level with two minimal edits:

1. **28.1** — swap only the governing-law words to "the laws of the State of New York" and delete the conflicting Singapore forum wording (no restatement of forum, since 28.2 already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County), curing the earlier 13→27 word expansion.
2. **28.2** — small same-sentence edit confining the temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out to "those courts", so law and forum form one permitted corresponding pair.

Element coverage: NY law by operation 1; exclusive state and federal court jurisdiction in New York County already met verbatim in 28.2.
